description: Several colorful plastic plates, bowls, and utensils are spread out on the table, with a yellow soap bottle off to the right. The left hand steadies a yellow plate in the center while the right hand holds a blue sponge cloth and wipes across the plate’s surface in short strokes, shifting the sponge from the middle toward the rim and back; the sponge cloth is the right-hand object and the plate is the left-hand object.
